vaerak-vaesto: Population at the end of the statistical reference period.
vaerak-kokmuutos: Increase of population, or total change is the difference between the population of two consecutive statistical reference periods.
kokmuutos_p: Increase of population, or total change is the difference between the population of two consecutive statistical reference periods. The difference has been divided by the population of the previous statistical reference period and then multiplied by one hundred.
vaerak-dem_huoltos: The demographic dependency ratio is calculated as the total number of persons age 0-14 and the number of persons aged 65 and older divided by the number of persons aged 15-64. The figure obtained is multiplied by one hundred.
vaerak-tal_huoltos: The economic dependency ratio is calculated by dividing the number of non-employed, that is, unemployed and inactive population, by the number of employed persons. The figure obtained is multiplied by one hundred.
vaesto_keski_ika: The average age is calculated by summing the ages of the persons and dividing the amount by the number of persons. The age of a person is defined as a person's age in whole years plus 0.5 years.

vaesto_askunta_skunta: Persons born in the area belonging to the population of Finland at the end of the year and living permanently in the area. That is, the persons area of birth is the same as the area of residence.
vaesto_askunta_eiskunta: Persons not born in the area belonging to the population of Finland at the end of the year and living permanently in the area. That is, the persons area of birth is not the same as the area of residence.
vaesto_askunta_skunta_p:
Share of permanent inhabitants born in the area among the permanent population in the area.
For example, 40.4 per cent of persons living permanently in Helsinki at the end of 2017 had been born in Helsinki.
vaesto_skunta_askunta_p:
Share of permanent inhabitants born in the area among all persons born in the area belonging to the population at the end of the year.
For example, 52.4 per cent of persons born in Helsinki belonging to the population were living permanently in Helsinki at the end of 2017.
